raw.details:
Overview

The Code Club Round 2 Technical Online Assessment is designed to evaluate candidates on algorithmic problem-solving, programming fundamentals, and core computer science knowledge.

The assessment combines coding challenges with technical multiple-choice questions to provide a balanced evaluation of a candidate's ability to reason, implement efficient solutions, and apply fundamental programming and computer science concepts.

Assessment Structure

  • 2 Coding Problems based on Data Structures, Algorithms, and Problem Solving
  • 2 Domain-Based MCQs covering core Computer Science concepts
  • 5 Programming Language MCQs testing programming fundamentals, code reasoning, and language-specific concepts

Assessment Guidelines

  • The assessment is to be attempted individually.
  • Candidates should carefully read the problem statements, constraints, and instructions before submitting their solutions.
  • Coding questions will be evaluated against multiple test cases, including hidden test cases.
  • Candidates are expected to consider both correctness and efficiency of their solutions.
  • Each candidate must complete the assessment within the specified duration.
  • Only submissions made within the allotted assessment period will be considered.
  • Candidates should ensure that their code handles the stated constraints and relevant edge cases.

Evaluation

Candidates will be evaluated based on:

  • Correctness of coding solutions
  • Algorithmic efficiency
  • Problem-solving ability
  • Programming fundamentals
  • Understanding of core computer science concepts

The assessment is designed to progressively evaluate candidates rather than relying solely on factual recall.

Important: Candidates should attempt the assessment independently and follow all assessment rules specified on the platform.
